# Add Unit Tests Skill

## Required Checks
- Tests cover success, failure, validation, and edge paths.
- Tests are isolated and readable.
- Assertions focus on observable behavior.

## Prohibited Actions
- Brittle tests dependent on internals.
- Marking work complete without tests.
